name: figures-human
description: Shared human-figure graphics kit: the walk rig, masc/femme bodies, generic wardrobe articles/items/sets (coats, boots, caps, hair, tool belts...), faces, palettes, and the base materials table. A story lists this module and then only ships the art unique to it, overriding any kit file by dropping its own copy at the same graphics/<kind>/<name>.json path. Settlement/scenery art (buildings, decorations, collision, interiors, the courier ship, the trade_ring station) moved out to orbital-std in 2.0.0 - it was never a figure or wardrobe piece.
